variants.briefing:
Hey,

I’m concerned a [Ship] moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around [Location], which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to [Destination]. 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to [Destination]. Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
